parts.desc: Aug delivered: latest update wins, ship date with cut-off/holiday roll and DC timezone
DHX on-time: 1-day SLA, business days per DC calendar incl. holidays, Saturday deliveries
worst carrier: per-carrier on-time over delivered Q3 shipments
SIN1 freight: volumetric billable weight rounded up, inclusive bands, returned/in-transit billed, cancelled not
ATL1 transit: US holidays (Jul 3, Sep 7), UTC-4 dates, 15:00 cut-off
late by country: on-time rule applied per shipment
stuck parcels: only the latest update counts; earlier in_transit rows of delivered parcels are noise
UPG billable kg: volumetric max then ceil per parcel, corrected weights from later updates
